source_note: 爱塔传奇实地调查的千佛殿完整近正面照片作主要形制输入，Commons近照核门窗、厚墙与斗栱。去除园景、石碑、火具与文字，少量透视保留以呈现歇山侧面。仅绘现存北宋千佛殿，不把后唐经幢纪年当作木殿年代，不含1980年代修复的卧佛殿。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a refined fine-line heritage architecture plate for the Chinese collection 访古.
Image 1 is ONLY the STYLE MASTER: the Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its delicate, elegant, slightly organic fine strokes, restrained detail, large unmarked white surfaces and consistent sparse visual density.
Image 2 is the PRIMARY SUBJECT GEOMETRY photo: the actual Northern Song Qianfo Hall (千佛殿), Chongqing Temple, Changzi, Shanxi, built 1016. It shows the entire roof and front wall. Image 3 is a closer supplementary photograph of the SAME HALL, supporting the facade openings and brackets. Neither photo is a style reference.
Draw this actual small THREE-BAY hall almost straight-on, with just a slight view of its left side, upright verticals. Preserve its single-eaved hip-and-gable roof, very broad projecting eaves, sweeping corner tips, low long main ridge, paired ridge-end finials and one small central ridge finial. Preserve the square brick-and-plaster facade close to the outer column plane, ONE narrow central closed double wooden door and TWO wide rectangular side windows of straight vertical bars; thick plain solid masonry between openings. DO NOT create an open columned veranda, lattice door facade, extra windows or second roof storey. The roof is visibly much wider than the masonry body. Preserve the real large bracket groups and exposed beams under its eaves as a few clean structural outlines. Keep the modest raised stone platform and short central stair; omit the surrounding garden fence and furniture.
Use sparse BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE with ALL roof, wall, door, window and recess surfaces WHITE. The broad roof plane should stay nearly blank with at most 12–16 widely separated fine descending lines, no transverse tile joints, no repeated arcs. No brick courses across walls; only platform edges and a few joints. Render each window with only fine separated vertical bars and white gaps, never black fill. Keep central door simple planks with fine outer frame; do not simulate its peeling paint. Draw small ridge ornaments only as selective thin silhouettes, without dense filigree.
Remove trees, foliage, sky, adjacent buildings, people, incense burners, fence, modern signs, plaque lettering, lantern, fire extinguishers, stone memorial slabs and all pavement texture. No invented new buildings or interior sculptures. No solid shadow, grey shading, black-filled opening, hatching, pencil grain, texture, color, gold, words, watermark, border or frame.
Landscape 1536×1024. Center the entire building, including both roof corners, all ridge finials and complete base/stair, at approximately 82% canvas width with generous white margins. Nothing cropped. Only a few short ground lines. Preserve the compact Song hall's photographed proportions, not a generic grand Buddhist temple.

historical_sources.title: 崇庆寺
historical_sources.publisher: 长治日报、长治市人民政府
historical_sources.evidence: 千佛殿1016年，三间六椽单檐歇山；大士殿主体及十八罗汉1079年，部分墙体后修；卧佛殿20世纪80年代修复。寺内后唐经幢与唐造像说明早期活动，不等于现存殿宇年代。

site_recommendation.lede: 崇庆寺千佛殿坐落在紫云山坡，宽檐覆住朴素的三间厚墙。北宋木构与寺中宋代罗汉彩塑相邻，让建筑与塑像的不同纪年可以在一座小寺中对读。

facts.label: 1016年宋构
facts.text: 千佛殿始于北宋大中祥符九年，面阔三间、进深六椽，单檐歇山顶，现存主体按宋构登记。

facts.label: 宽檐厚墙
facts.text: 墙面紧贴檐柱平面，中央木门与两侧直棂窗收在大屋檐之下，檐下斗栱粗壮清楚。

facts.label: 宋塑相邻
facts.text: 寺内大士殿与十八罗汉有1079年纪年，墙体和其他殿宇另有后修；本图仅描绘千佛殿。
